description: Agent playbook for one published use case, by slug. Signed-out calls are an HTTP 401 so the client can open Sign in to The AI Integration Hub; the library tools stay public. After sign-in the JSON access field is full (follow the playbook, then offer its schedule only if the user confirms), free_claim_available (ask, and set claim true only after the user says yes), or preview with reason upgrade (show preview, prices, and the purchase links exactly, then stop). An error means that slug has no agent. Do not invent the playbook or a price. The user's business data stays in the chat.

claim.description: Set true only after this tool has offered the slug as the account's one free agent.

slug.description: Use case slug, such as sales-forecasting.
